title: Goa Heritage & Hinterland
shortDescription: Five days beyond the beaches — Old Goa's baroque churches, the painted lanes of Fontainhas, a spice plantation lunch and the mighty Dudhsagar Falls.
description: There's far more to Goa than its coastline. This journey shows you the soul of the state: the UNESCO-listed churches of Old Goa, the colourful Latin Quarter of Panaji, and family-run spice farms tucked into the Western Ghats.

You'll stay in a restored Portuguese-era heritage home in Panaji for two nights, then move to a peaceful South Goa resort — with a jeep safari to Dudhsagar Falls and a final day of beach time to round it off.

price.note: Heritage stay + beach resort. Flights not included.

hero.alt: The white baroque church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception in Panaji

gallery.alt: A seaside chapel framed by palms
Palm trees on the Goan coast

highlights: Guided walk through Fontainhas, Panaji's Latin Quarter
Basilica of Bom Jesus and Sé Cathedral in Old Goa
Spice plantation tour with a traditional Goan lunch
Jeep safari to the four-tiered Dudhsagar Falls
Two nights in a restored Portuguese heritage home

itinerary.title: Arrive in Panaji
itinerary.description: Transfer to your heritage home in Panaji. In the late afternoon, join a local guide for a walk through Fontainhas — ochre and indigo houses, azulejo tiles and tiny bakeries.

itinerary.title: Old Goa & spice country
itinerary.description: Visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus, home to the relics of St Francis Xavier, and the vast Sé Cathedral. Continue to a spice plantation in Ponda for a guided walk and a traditional lunch served on banana leaves.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Falls, then south
itinerary.description: Jeep safari through Bhagwan Mahavir Sanctuary to Dudhsagar Falls — at its most dramatic just after the monsoon. Continue to your South Goa resort.

itinerary.title: Beach day in South Goa
itinerary.description: A free day on the quiet beaches of the south. Optional dolphin-spotting boat trip from Palolem or a visit to Cabo de Rama fort.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your journey home.

inclusions: 2 nights in a heritage homestay and 2 nights at a beach resort
Daily breakfast, one dinner and a plantation lunch
Guided Fontainhas walk and Old Goa tour
Private AC car for transfers and sightseeing
knowBeforeYouGo: Dudhsagar jeep safaris are closed during the peak monsoon (mid-June to September)
Shoulders and knees should be covered when visiting churches

seo.description: 5-day Goa heritage holiday with Fontainhas, Old Goa churches, a spice plantation and Dudhsagar Falls. From ₹21,499 per person.
